nodes.label: Off-white rounded home building with an arched doorway
nodes.rationale: 58×58 SVG, no stroke or text, one even-odd path filled #F7F7FB. The silhouette is a rounded building: a top cap (about x 9–49, y 6–20), a wider middle body (x 1–57, y 20–37), and two lower legs (left about x 6–25, right x 33–54, y 38–52) split by an open arched doorway whose crown is (29, 34). Four cutouts read as windows: a top rounded rectangle (x 13–45, y 10–20), a wide middle window (x 5–53, y 24–34) whose bottom edge rises to y=30 at the center, and a rounded window in each leg.
